events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the incomparable John Cleese! From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to 'Fawlty Towers,' what's your favourite moment from the comedy icon?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track is your essential listen?

angles.name: Remembering Freddie

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
